name: Heart Light: Knight of the Gnomes
storyline: Heart Light: Knight of the Gnomes is a first-person dungeon crawler set in a grim fairy-tale world inherited by gnomekind after humanity vanished. Put on your trusty tool belt, dust off your cap, and become the first of your kind to uncover the fate of the ancient builders. As you stray further from sunlight, your perception of the dungeon changes, opening new opportunities and greater dangers.
summary: Descend as a gnomish knight into the ancient dungeons of a grim fairy tale, where your courage changes what you see. Mark the walls, link Ley spells, brew potions, and uncover the lost human world before your Heart Light fades.
